file_roles.evidence: waitForJobToEnd did 'if (finishedJobIds.contains(jobId)) {...return true;} sparkListener.wait(); return false;'; diff changes it to 'while (!finishedJobIds.contains(jobId)) { sparkListener.wait(); }', fixing the spurious-wakeup bug.

rationale: The test sees 'Unexpected job execution status RUNNING' because waitForJobToEnd returned before the job finished, after a spurious wakeup from wait(). The reporter's diagnosis and the diff match: a single wait() replaced by a while loop on the finished set. The exception is thrown in SparkStatsUtil, outside the gold file.
